content: Dioni babadaido minu feari odobake wei wake
Erodi, dawae gaemani dai mi. Dawa Yesunu buna ukeka wake nauiba ibake danu waiya ukeka oroubake eno wei, i miye Dioni babadaido mi. Dawa fearike uyari ibake i buna ukekae ibake i ari eno ukakua wei.
Adinaro Erodima Dioni ana ebaro odi. Erodima danu nabue Firifunu aweka Erodiasi waira uke muni.
Eno uiro Dionima dawabake wei, anu nabuenu aweka muneka i ba mewereya media eno wei.

Eno weiro Firifunu aweka Erodiasima dino uike areare weibi ibake Erodima Dioni ana ebaro odike ma feafine wei. Eno weiro i orouma yaisina Dioni Godinu we bou ukeka miya we imuisa ibake Erodima ia iyarike Dioni ma feare daui.
Dubuenaro Erodinu doka odo fariro banau daiwere uiro eme keuwere banau ifisane faka. Ido fakaro uruna iseibisabaie Erodiasinu aruma emenu ibooro yaura ureibiro Erodima imuka ubarenaro rooro ui.
Rooro uike i orou naukeibisaro i arumabake eno wei, anemerabu mufane wefakuie abake mamauanea eno wake bunawere wei.
Eno weiro i aruma danu amaema wei ibake i arumama Erodibake eno wei, Dioni babadaido ukeka minu bokaifu naberoro odiake maina wei.
Eno weibaie Erodima imuka merama imuike. Nono bunawere we bou uiro danu banau iseibisa orou nauisa ibake Erodima enaenari ui.
Dawama weiro Danu orouma ana ebaro anisake Dioni faya kuukake bokaifu naberoro oisa.
Eno uisake ane fakake i arumabairo makaro i arumama munike ane danu amaebairo mairo eri.
Eno uisaro Dioninu iwoka ukeka orouma ane ana ebaro fakake Dioninu ofe mukake ane dooro daune oisa. Dooro daune oisake Yesubairo anisake i uisabai yaisina weisaro naui.
Yesuma i eme fai dausini (5,000) uruna marie wake
Yesuma i wake ido nauike i orofa ido medike boudi ubarenaro amuike eme ibe me orofaro ani. Aniro eme keuwere Dawa moi orofaro anibai nauisake i goi goiroma udiro eneebe Dawabairo faka.
Fakaro Yesuma kuna ekabokenaro farike gibudiro enarike i orou yaisina eraada imukari ui. Imukari urieba ibake emenu ofe arama uke ibisa orou ma wiromirie.

Dumu sineibiro Yesunu iwoka ukeka orouma Dawabairo fakake eno weisa, yewa orofae eme ibe me orofaya weisa. Nono dumu sinao ufekua i orou wearo yaisina goi goiro anifisake uruna oima make mune ifisa weisa.
Eno weisaro Yesuma ma owerike eno wei, anemebake anifeisa weike wei, emuabake uruna mayakawero ifisa wei.
Eno weiro emuama eno weisa, iyabairo buredi faini (5) adua abu kai raarayai i mane ibinisaya weisa.
Eno weisaro Yesuma waure aarawe wei.

Waure aarawe weike weiro i orou yaisina bagibagi koe fafaro yauka. Yaukaro Yesuma i buredi faini (5) adua abu kai raarayaini munike urero eraada Godi we ma irauaiai uike i buredi ma birabira yarike Danu iwoka ukeka oroubairo mariero emuama i kuku uke ibisa oroubairo naka naka uisaro isa.
I orou yaisina isaro boana urie. Ise me sikaro iuwa iuwabai mukake bosearo youkaro bosea duwero (12) wake faka.
Eme keuwere fai dausinini (5,000) awekabo aruma amaraini i uruna idua isa.
Yesuma kuna duboro eneibi wake
Yesuma weiro Danu iwoka ukeka orou emuako boudiro amuisake ekara enaro siraa yafisane uisa. Siraa yafisane uisaro Yesuma i kuku uke ibisa oroubairo weiro nauisake anisa.
Anisaro Yesu Danu mane guriguri ufine oraara oko kairo amuke ani. Amuke anike dumu siniro Danu mane iro ibi.
Yesu iro ibibaie i boudi kuna abanaro fari. Fariro oyau fariro kuna ufe uyariro i orou ekabokenaro ane dauisa. Wai awanakuro Yesuma kuna adua duboro enaenare emuabairo fari.
Yesu emuabairo faribaie Danu iwoka ukeka orouma Dawa ekake ia iyarada arua daiwere weisake weisa, ie imumua weisa.
Eno weisabaie Yesuma emuabake eno wei, imuka ara uaweke yewae Naya, ia da iyawe wei.
Eno weiro Fidama wei, Dai Waria Mi, A dawa ba Yesubaie wearo kuna adua duboro Abairo aama wei.
Eno weiro Yesuma aara wei. Weibaie Fidama boudiroma aduaro isarike Yesubairo ani.
Aneibibaie oyau fariro kuna ufe uyariro Fidama ibai erike ia iyarada adua ubarenaro imu i. Imu isaada daiwere wei, Dai Waria Mi, na ma wiroa wei.
Weiro Yesuma Fidanu wanaro sabu munike eno wei, ae imukeka dai menaku miya wei! Anemebake imuke dakinu wei!
Eno weiro boudi ubarenaro amuisiro oyau ido me sini.
Enoba i boudi ubarenaro yaure ibisa orouma Yesubairo guriguri ukaada eno weisa, Ae Godinu ba Amaraya weisa.
Yesuma Genesareda orofaro arama ukeibirie orou ma wiroimirie wake
Kuna ekabokenaro siraa yakake Genesareda orofaro ane enaka.
Enakaro i orofa orouma Yesu iwoka uisake emenu arama uke ibisa orou Dawabairo waure fare odirieka.
Odiriekaro i arama uke ibisa orouma eno weisa, Anu wau fifiro ure burifene weaisia weisa. Eno weisake i orouma Yesunu wau fifiro ure burisake idua wiroisa.
